question: (1)/(30) { is what percentage of } (2)/(20) { (rounded off to two decimal places)?}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required percentage = (Value ÷ Base value) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (1/30 ÷ 2/20) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (1/30 × 20/2) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (1/3) × 100 = 100/3 % ≈ 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Value = 1/30

Base value = 2/20 = 1/10

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Given Value ÷ Base Value) × 100
